Quote ACCEPTED → Dispatch OPEN with a candidate snapshot accepting a quote opens its dispatch automatically with the configured TTL
Quote ACCEPTED → Dispatch OPEN with a candidate snapshot offers only ACTIVE providers with ACTIVE coverage for the zone and service type
Quote ACCEPTED → Dispatch OPEN with a candidate snapshot keeps the acceptance when nobody is eligible: OPEN dispatch without candidates, flagged noProviderAvailable
Quote ACCEPTED → Dispatch OPEN with a candidate snapshot repeated and concurrent acceptances keep 1 ACCEPTED quote and 1 dispatch
Quote ACCEPTED → Dispatch OPEN with a candidate snapshot is atomic: if the dispatch cannot be created the quote is not accepted
Provider claiming Provider Admin A lists available work (OFFER view without contacts) and claims it
Provider claiming blocks non-candidates, wrong memberships, SUPER_ADMIN, DRIVER and IntegrationClient
Provider claiming release: A claims → A releases → A cannot reclaim → B claims; only the owner releases
Claim concurrency several providers claiming at once: exactly one winner, consistent database
Expiration and cancellation an expired dispatch cannot be claimed and is persisted as EXPIRED
Expiration and cancellation cancelling the delivery request cancels OPEN and CLAIMED dispatches, keeping the claim owner
Expiration and cancellation enforces dispatch invariants in PostgreSQL
Audit records dispatch events without tokens, secrets or customer contact data
